causal_path: The imaging pass flies 24 m above ground over a 12 m roof.
Tracking error and site-model error reduce the nominal clearance.
Clearance to the roof may fall below the 3 m success criterion.

supporting_references.summary: Operator requires at least 3 m obstacle clearance.
A coarse warehouse envelope model is supplied.
Catalog mechanism for static obstacle clearance.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: The site model is a coarse, non-survey envelope.

confirm_if.description: The swept route intersects site geometry.

falsify_if.description: Clearance stays above the criterion along the whole route.

causal_path: Forecast wind and payload mass raise route power demand.
Integrated route energy consumes the usable pack energy.
The landing reserve may fall below the declared fraction.

supporting_references.summary: Operator declares a 20 percent landing reserve.
Catalog mechanism for route energy demand.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: Forecast wind is not a route-local measurement and the pack energy is a nameplate value.

confirm_if.description: Landing reserve falls below the declared fraction.

falsify_if.description: Remaining energy exceeds the reserve at landing.

causal_path: The camera payload adds mass to the configured aircraft.
Total takeoff mass may exceed the declared maximum.

supporting_references.summary: Aircraft record declares a 6.0 kg maximum takeoff mass.

hypotheses.uncertainty_reason: Masses come from the aircraft and payload records.

confirm_if.description: Configured takeoff mass exceeds the declared limit.

falsify_if.description: Configured takeoff mass is within the declared limit.
